proposals.title: Item 4: Policy to Use GAAP Financial Metrics for Purposes of Determining Executive Compensation
proposals.proponent: Chevy Chase Trust Company, as Trustee of the AFL-CIO Equity Index Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the HRCC to adopt a policy using GAAP rather than non-GAAP metrics when evaluating performance for determining senior executive compensation.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
